semantics.how: Sums duplicate same-direction import weights then takes the maximum of the two directions, skipping self and unknown edges
semantics.what: Computes undirected affinity for each file pair
semantics.why: Stops high fan-in utilities being pulled into clusters by many weak edges

semantics.how: Checks every file appears exactly once, nothing extra appears and keys match their membership, throwing on any violation
semantics.what: Validates that cluster groups form a strict partition of the files
semantics.why: Deterministic output that violates the contract is a bug, so it fails loudly instead of being repaired

semantics.how: Starts from singletons, repeatedly merges the pair with the highest linkage over retained edges until no positive linkage remains, then canonicalises with toGroups
semantics.what: Partitions files by weighted agglomerative single-linkage clustering
semantics.why: Deterministic and total, replacing an LLM clustering call

semantics.how: Hashes the sorted file list into a short id prefixed for layers
semantics.what: Derives a layer id from its file membership
semantics.when: Called when building layers from clusters
semantics.why: Ids from membership stay stable even when names change between runs

semantics.how: Takes the maximum retained affinity across all cross pairs and also returns the total
semantics.what: Scores two clusters by their strongest retained member pair
semantics.when: Called by clusterFiles when choosing merges
semantics.why: Average linkage diluted real relationships as clusters grew

semantics.how: Claims carried-over names first, then assigns new names in id order, suffixing collisions
semantics.what: Produces the canonical ordered layer list with unique names
semantics.why: Names stay identical across the snapshot, the artifact and the next run's carry-over

semantics.how: Computes each file's strongest incident weight first, then keeps an edge only when its weight clears the threshold relative to both ends
semantics.what: Keeps only edges significant at both endpoints
semantics.why: Primary defence against single-linkage chaining through hubs

semantics.how: Computes each cluster's id and inserts groups in ascending id order
semantics.what: Builds the canonical id-keyed cluster map
semantics.why: Byte-stable ordering makes serialised output deterministic
